messages:
acme_corp_ops: Hey — running into a billing gap. We applied a promo code for a test org and a couple of requests completed successfully but the promo balance didn't drop. Triggered from our client which retried once on a 429 and then got a 200. Can provide request ids.

alex_support: Thanks — sorry about that. Can you paste one of the failing request ids and a short repro (curl or SDK call) so we can trace? Also which promo code/credit id?

acme_corp_ops: sure: request_id=req_20260317_9f4b2a, promo_id=promo:SPRING2026:org:acme123. Repro (simplified):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx" 
  -H "X-Request-Id: req_20260317_9f4b2a" 
  -d '{"model":"rw-1-shot","input":"hello"}'
```
Client retried once after a 429, then got 200 and response body looked correct. UI still shows full promo balance.

alex_support: Got it. @jess_billing can you look for ledger events for request_id=req_20260317_9f4b2a and promo_id? If there's a known edge-case on retries we'll escalate.

jess_billing: Looking now. I can see the request in the usage queue but there's no corresponding debit event in the ledger table for that request_id. There's a recent bug where finalize hooks can fail to emit a consume_event when the stream finalization path takes the retry branch — especially for short sessions. Filing a follow-up.

ryan_infra: I pulled the service logs for req_20260317_9f4b2a. Trace shows: initial attempt -> 429 client-throttled -> retry -> success. The finalize job attempted to write a usage-record and got a transient write timeout to the usage-store: `ERROR UsageWriter.write timeout: 500ms`. The retry flow marked request as completed but the finalize callback returned 202 (ack) without enqueueing the debit due to a missing ack-and-commit handshake in that edge path.

billing-bot: automated-event: ledger.reconcile_needed { "request_id": "req_20260317_9f4b2a", "reason": "missing_consume_event", "detected_by": "billing-audit-2026-03-17" }

alex_support: Thanks @ryan_infra and @jess_billing. Acme — we should be able to manually credit your account or run an automated reconcile. Which do you prefer while we patch? :slightly_smiling_face:

acme_corp_ops: Manual please — we need the promo available for demos this afternoon.

alex_support: Understood. I'll queue a manual adjustment now and follow up with confirmation once the credit delta is added. Ticket created: INFR-4521 — root cause: finalize path didn't emit consume_event on retry->success with transient usage-store timeout. Planning a fix to make finalize idempotent and retry commits.

jess_billing: I pushed a one-off ledger entry to reflect the 1.2k token debit for req_20260317_9f4b2a against promo:SPRING2026:org:acme123. Will include audit metadata linking to req id and support ticket.

billing-bot: automated-event: ledger.manual_adjustment { "adjustment_id": "adj_20260317_0007", "org": "acme123", "amount_tokens": "1200", "reason": "support_manual_repair", "linked_request": "req_20260317_9f4b2a" }

acme_corp_ops: Confirmed — promo balance decremented and demo looks good. Thanks for quick turnaround. :tada:

alex_support: Great — closing this thread. We'll follow up in INFR-4521 with the rollout ETA for the finalize robustness fix and a postmortem. If anything else pops up ping me directly.
